name: Hugebouquets.com
description: A Shopify store selling oversized bouquets (100 roses wrapped, $279; 200 white roses, $536; "from $95") with same-day delivery in LA (homepage). Seller: "All orders come through Google organic search. The site's average position on Google is 7.2. Dropshipping-style fulfillment: orders are forwarded to florists who assemble and deliver bouquets. ~30 minutes/week to manage" (seller-stated). Founded Dec 2024, US.

mentions.indieAngle: Same lead-router model for any city + premium-gift search in PL: "duże bukiety Warszawa/Kraków", "100 róż z dostawą", balloon or cake delivery. Build one SEO site per city, forward orders to local kwiaciarnie (florists) on commission, and invoice from one entity.

whyItPrints: Flowers are a pure "intent" search that peaks around holidays. There's no inventory, the florist does the work, and the site is a lead router with a margin. L30 profit margin is 65%, and the seller says it takes 30 minutes a week.
